# Assessment of Sustainable Tourism Development Plan

## Novelty (originality, unexpectedness): 3/5
**Why?** The solution presents a comprehensive, well-structured approach that incorporates many established best practices in sustainable tourism (carrying capacity assessments, benefit-sharing mechanisms, certification programs, phased implementation).
